classification.difficultyReason: The source labels this practice Development. Students infer equal opposite sides of rectangles, add decimal or fractional lengths, and convert units in part h.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of these rectangles.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four filled right-angle markers; both horizontal sides labelled 8 cm and both vertical sides labelled 5 cm.
spec.mathematics: All four supplied measurements are retained. Perimeter is the sum of the four side lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and angle markers are permanent givens; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four filled right-angle markers, 8 cm below and 5 cm to the right.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides of the rectangle have equal lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}P &= 8+5+8+5\\P &= 26\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four filled right-angle markers, 1.8 m below and 80 cm to the right.
spec.mathematics: The mixed units must be converted before adding; opposite sides are equal.
spec.answerVisibility: The mixed-unit givens remain unchanged; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}80\text{ cm} &= 0.8\text{ m}\\P &= 1.8+0.8\\&\quad +1.8+0.8\\P &= 5.2\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with four filled right-angle markers, stacked fraction 9/5 m below and stacked fraction 4/5 m to the right.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides are equal. Add the four exact fractions with denominator 5 and retain the fractional answer.
spec.answerVisibility: Fractional givens are permanent; the supplied perimeter answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
$$\begin{align*}P &= \frac{9}{5}+\frac{4}{5}+\frac{9}{5}+\frac{4}{5}\\P &= \frac{9+4+9+4}{5}\\P &= \frac{26}{5}\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
